parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen of the display, made primarily of glass with a thin protective layer. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays images, videos, and text. It serves as the primary output interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed and does not move, though it may tilt slightly depending on the mount or stand design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of durable plastic. It supports the screen and maintains stability on a surface.
parts.Functional_description: The base provides structural support and balance to the display, preventing it from tipping over.
parts.Movement_description: The base is typically stationary, though some designs allow limited rotation or tilt adjustment.
